name: unservable-resources
about: #92: an item needs a capability no runner offers (macos, while the only runners have none). loopd flags it the moment triage sets its resources: an unservable event naming what is missing, one mention of the user in the thread and a badge on the board, before any clock moves, so without waiting for the orchestrator's idle limit or a turn. More polls and a 3h idle stretch do not repeat it. When a runner offering macos claims, the flag clears and that runner gets the item.
